calibration.complete_absence: one separate public-absence bin with same Jeffreys smoothing; no forced-zero probability or direct abstention override
calibration.ece: ten fixed equal-width bins on runtime-quantized probabilities; report ID separately and full population; native field is maximum ECE across calibration/verification and ID/full
calibration.id: three bins with 1/3,2/3 quantile cuts fixed using development ID predictions, then calibrated probability is (successes+.5)/(count+1) on calibration role ID bin
calibration.verification: only once after immutable calibrator freeze; no fitting or threshold changes

cost_scope.native_tick: actual resident head, sparse kernel, journal fsync and separate outer wall including durable witness; measure real global allocator peak delta
cost_scope.new_profile_limit: does not qualify old cold Python generation feature driver, Agentd/fleet, intuition, target production host or mutation authority
cost_scope.upstream: full generation and public draft encoder feature preparation separately retained; batched timing is throughput only; additional serial end-to-end sample measured

development_design: train pairs4000..4999:200 per same five ID views;5000..5999:complete absence; these are development only, not external validation
independent_unit: one previously registered no-replacement original image pair; exactly one generated output and label per pair

native_mapping.observation: the508 bounded Q24 public features, bound to original generator/sources/profile
native_mapping.ood: residual=1-p; this is correctness-risk used for declared absence detection, not universal epistemic OOD probability
native_mapping.prediction: [Q24(calibrated predicted probability of actual joint correctness),same first31 features]
native_mapping.residual: max absolute difference =1-p; first component is a constant success reference; this is an explicit confidence encoding adapter, NOT a measured future latent-dynamics prediction

predictor.labels: actual reopened PNG and UTF-8 joint correctness under frozen independent primary observer and original target; labels are offline only
predictor.prediction_freeze: exact selected parameters and all dependency pins before neuron_calibration access
predictor.profile: resident observed-output correctness head; not a future-dynamics predictor
predictor.training: Adam lr .002 weight_decay .0001 batch128 2000 steps; evaluate development BCE every100 and choose lowest; tie earliest

qualification_design.ood_definition: both visual panels and masks zero; both digit hints unknown; keep/swap command visible
qualification_design.per_role: first800 pairs:160 per five ID views;last800 disjoint pairs:complete absence
qualification_design.scope_limit: Only this complete-absence mechanism. Semantic failure is not relabeled as OOD. No general OOD claim.
